array.string: set -a; source /Users/daniildegtyarev/.config/roehub/roehub.env; set +a; export CH_DATABASE=${CH_DATABASE:-market_data}; export CH_USER=${CH_USER:-${CLICKHOUSE_USER:-roe}}; export CH_PASSWORD=${CH_PASSWORD:-${CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD:-}}; export CLICKHOUSE_EXPORTER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=${CLICKHOUSE_EXPORTER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-5.0}; export CLICKHOUSE_EXPORTER_VERIFY_TLS=0; cd /opt/roehub/app; exec /opt/roehub/app/.venv/bin/python -m apps.monitoring.clickhouse_exporter --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9116 --scrape-uri http://127.0.0.1:8123/
